title: ロボット応用力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Dynamics of Machine Systems II
keywords: Solving equation of motion 2.Free and forced vibration 3.Natural angular frequency 4.Damping ratio, damped natural frequency 5.Resonance phenomenon
educationalGoal: Acquire basic knowledge about machinery vibration problems. Understand the basics of vibration and apply it to machine design. Model and analyze basic vibration phenomena.
advice: In recent years, high speed and high precision have been achieved to improve productivity, but vibrations generated in various machines cause problems. In this course, it is necessary to understand how to derive and solve the equations for expressing the motion of various vibration models. Therefore, students must not only understand the lectures but also work on exercises and reports the help them acquire the ability to solve vibration problems. The following topics are covered: 1.Basics of mechanical vibration: equations of motion, simple vibration, harmonic vibration, vectors, and complex representation of vibration 2.Free vibration of a one-degree-of-freedom system without damping 3.Free vibration of a one-degree-of-freedom system with damping 4.Forced vibration of a one-degree-of-freedom system 5.Basics of vibration of a two-degree-of-freedom system
books: Textbook: Basic Vibration Engineering (2nd Edition) [Kyoritsu Shuppan]
requiredKnowledge: Review Robot Basic Mechanics I & II and Robot Applied Dynamics I in addition to mathematics such as trigonometric functions and differential equations.

activityGoals.body: Model vibration phenomena and derive equations of motion.
Understand and explain the characteristics of the free vibration system with and without damping.
Understand and explain the characteristics of the forced vibration system with and without damping.
Understand and explain the characteristics of a two-degree-of-freedom vibration system using eigenvalue analysis
